plan.reason: Low dimension (5) and early budget use (24/100) with zero recent improvement and stagnation 5 favor balanced exploration over exploitation. Auto surrogate adapts between RBF and quadratic as data grows. current_to_best gives adaptive step sizing toward best for smoother convergence. Raising exploration to 0.5 adds novelty pressure in acquisition to escape the plateau, while moderate radius 0.15 and local_fraction 0.25 keep some local refinement without over-committing. Smaller population (30) and 6 generations per cycle leave room for more surrogate refits within the fixed budget.

Auto keeps the flexible surrogate choice as more data arrives. current_to_best gives adaptive directional steps toward the incumbent for smoother convergence, with a slightly higher mutation (0.7) and crossover (0.9) to promote diversity after stagnation. Exploration 0.75 increases acquisition diversity pressure, while local_fraction 0.2 and radius 0.2 keep modest local refinement without over-committing. A lean population of 28 with 6 generations per cycle preserves budget for more surrogate refits.

With only 36 evaluations left, the priority is escaping the plateau through increased novelty pressure rather than more exploitation. Raising exploration to 1.1 weights the distance term more heavily so the acquisition favors under-sampled regions; a moderate local_fraction (0.25) and radius (0.18) retain some refinement without burning budget. Auto keeps the surrogate adaptive as data accumulates, and current_to_best with slightly higher mutation (0.8) and crossover (0.85) promotes directional diversity. A lean population of 26 over 6 generations per cycle preserves budget for additional surrogate refits.

Severe stagnation (38) with zero recent improvement and near-interpolating surrogate (CV RMSE ~3e-5) means the model is overfitting a flat plateau. With only 16 evaluations left, budget must prioritize escaping the plateau. Increasing exploration to 1.5 strongly favors under-sampled novelty regions to break the plateau, while lowering local_fraction (0.15) redirects effort away from local refinement. current_to_best with high mutation (0.9) and crossover (0.9) promotes directional diversity toward the best while exploring. A smaller population (24) over fewer generations (5) keeps per-cycle cost low, allowing more surrogate refits as data accrues. Auto retains adaptivity between RBF and quadratic as the sparse final samples arrive.
